# Form Factory Games 2026 – fitness race in Prague

> Form Factory Games is an individual fitness race at Form Factory Vinohradská (Vinohradská 190, Praha 3, Czech Republic) on 5 December 2026: 3 workouts, 4 categories, up to 100 athletes. Organized by STR2G and Form Factory; head organizer Ladislav Suchánek.

## Main pages
- [Race info (Czech)](https://formfactorygames.cz/), [English](https://formfactorygames.cz/en/), [Polski](https://formfactorygames.cz/pl/), [Deutsch](https://formfactorygames.cz/de/)
